Repo: seo (Shopify app; Firebase Functions + theme app extension; jest 24 run from repo root: `npx jest --ci <path>`). Two Slack bug threads, one MR (same files).

T2 (iconic-rugs-au, https://avadaio.slack.com/archives/G01N5G8D562/p1791115075459679): Product JSON-LD Offer emits "validFrom": "2030-01-01" — tells Google the price is not valid until 2030. Default in packages/functions/src/config/default.js:121 `validFrom: '2030-01-01'`. Liquid only checks `!= blank`, never a future date, and ignores excludeFields: extensions/theme-app-extension/snippets/avada-product-and-collection.liquid:284-285 and :389-390; legacy copies in packages/functions/src/config/customGsdLiquid.js:290-291 and :615-616 (the :615 one is inside ratingReviewsStructured, which may not have an `excludeFields` variable — assign it from productAndCollection.excludeFields the same way line 27 does). Prod: 196 shops currently emit validFrom 2030 on storefront. CS set excludeFields "validFrom" for the shop and it had no effect.
Fix: (1) default.js:121 → `validFrom: ''` (leave priceValidUntil alone). (2) In each of the 4 places, emit validFrom only when not blank AND <= today (`{%- assign avadaToday = 'now' | date: '%Y-%m-%d' -%}`, string compare works for YYYY-MM-DD) AND `excludeFields` does not contain "validFrom". Keep the JSON valid (watch the leading comma at the extension sites and the trailing comma at :616). No data migration.

T4 (ladyandoscar, https://avadaio.slack.com/archives/G01N5G8D562/p1791102519313699): fake AggregateRating 5 stars / 1 review on every product page of a shop with no reviews. extensions/theme-app-extension/snippets/avada-rating-and-review.liquid:72-77 and customGsdLiquid.js ratingReviewsStructured (~:600-606) print `"ratingValue": {% if ratingValue > 0 %}...{% else %}5{% endif %}`, `"reviewCount": ... else 1`. Fake ratings risk a Google manual action for structured-data spam.
Fix: emit the whole aggregateRating object only when `appReview != 'ali-reviews' and ratingValue > 0 and reviewCount > 0`; delete the 5/1 fallbacks. The Product object must stay valid JSON without it (offers remain).

Do NOT touch getStructuredSetting.js or the UI toggle (separate product decision). Do not touch packages/functions/src/config/integration/appList.js (another task owns it).

TDD: add failing tests first in packages/functions/src/config/__tests__/customGsdLiquid.jsonld.test.js (it already renders these templates with liquidjs; follow its patterns): validFrom future → absent; past → present; excludeFields contains validFrom → absent; JSON parses in every case. Rating: no reviews → no aggregateRating key, JSON parses; 4.5/3 → exactly 4.5 and 3. For the two extension snippets, add a test file packages/functions/src/config/__tests__/themeExtensionSchemaGuards.test.js that renders the snippet files with the same liquidjs setup if feasible (read file from extensions/theme-app-extension/snippets/); if a snippet cannot render under liquidjs, fall back to a source-level assertion (no `{% else %}5{% endif %}` / `else %}1`, and validFrom guarded by the date + excludeFields condition) and say so in a comment. The commit message for the extension change must include [deploy-extensions] in its title.

contract.goal: Product JSON-LD never emits a future or excluded validFrom, and never emits an AggregateRating without real reviews
